row: Samaritan Medical Center (Watertown, New York) is a 294-bed community medical center. Affiliated facilities also include a 272-bed and 288-bed long term care facilities, community healthcare clinics and satellite testing services. Samaritan's mission is to offer a full range of high quality, comprehensive, and compassionate healthcare services to meet the needs of the military and civilian community. The organization's strong commitment to its mission is accomplished through the dedication of over 2,000 employees and 180+ physicians in 40 different medical specialties.
